title: 1.5 TB of VRAM on Mac Studio - RDMA over Thunderbolt 5
supports: Four M3 Ultra Mac Studios (1.5 TB unified memory) over RDMA/Thunderbolt 5 with exo ran Kimi K2 Thinking (1T) at 28.3 tok/s, macOS 26.2 (via search snippet)

title: Running a 1T parameter model on a $40K Mac Studio Cluster
supports: ~$40k Mac Studio cluster ran a 1T model at ~25 tok/s, ~2,000 ms time to first token, <450 W peak (via search snippet)

title: macOS Tahoe 26.2 adds the ability to connect multiple Macs to create AI clusters
supports: macOS 26.2 added RDMA over Thunderbolt for multi-Mac AI clusters (via search snippet)

title: NVIDIA Driver License Agreement (GeForce)
supports: GeForce driver licence s2.8: software not licensed for datacenter deployment (blockchain exception); term not defined (via search snippet)

title: GeForce RTX 5090 in the data center: EULA, P2P, cooling
supports: Whether a closet server or colo half-rack counts as datacenter deployment under the GeForce EULA is a question for counsel; RTX 5090 has no NVLink (via search snippet)

title: What the CMMC Pause Means for the Defense Industrial Base
supports: CMMC Phase 2 pause analysis; no resumption found in 2026-11-01 search (via search snippet)

supports: Compliance obligations (DFARS 7012 / NIST 800-171) and enforcement risk remain during the Phase II suspension (via search snippet)

title: CMMC for small business
